description: This Go source file contains test setup code for an embedded etcd server used in Kubernetes testing, including functions to configure, start, and manage the server within tests.

methods.name: getAvailablePorts
methods.description: Returns a list of available TCP ports for binding, attempting to bind to ephemeral ports.

methods.name: NewTestConfig
methods.description: Creates a new embedded etcd configuration with randomized ports and test-specific settings.

methods.name: RunEtcd
methods.description: Starts an embedded etcd server with the given configuration, returning a Kubernetes client connected to it, for use in tests.
